summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to reduce the maximum aggregate offering price of its at-the-market (ATM) common stock program from prior amounts to $2,116,998.60. The shares are sold under the existing Sales Agreement dated May 15, 2024, with H.C. Wainwright Co. as lead agent. The filing adjusts the remaining capacity under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3 and is a routine shelf takedown adjustment, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved.
